# the contributor audit of actual payment calibrations and one-facet credit

Sources read in full:

- `candidate 358e239a9d0e9d92`;
- `candidate e0241fcf7902a02f`;
- `candidate 101249feac4a4158`.

PASS with the continuity scope repair already made in the first source.
The first verifier was rerun with154 exact checks PASS. These are scoped
calibrations and a local geometric inequality, not a complete OC proof.

## Nonlinear old-path obstruction and actual one-input descent

The old common perspective pulls its actual speed times arclength back
to a fixed triangle edge with coefficient r_z^2. The captured profile
is symmetric, decreases away from the edge midpoint, and has exactly
the original mixed depth as its mean. The symmetric part of every
convex edge test increases away from that midpoint. The double-integral
covariance proof therefore has the claimed nonpositive sign. Summing
over the actual facets proves the response-weighted obstruction even
for normal-dependent common convex profiles. Actual realizations now
correctly require joint continuity and global finite convexity; no
unbounded discontinuous-in-normal field is implicitly used.

The new one-input path is a different field. Its exact mass and cap
polynomials agree with the independent root calculations and Slab's
source. The fixed and optimized caps have the same derivative and an
explicit4e^2 difference, so strict fixed-cover descent is sufficient.
The all-dimensional identity retains the proper vertex-cap regime;
it is not promoted to a global criticality theorem in that regime.

## Genuinely nonaffine truncated triangles

The source cites a previously certified all-normal critical example,
and keeps that dependency explicit. Its ordinary centroid coordinate
has strictly positive second derivative in the outer radius, so the
three centroid points really are nonaffine. Symmetry reduces the two
projective-centroid equations to the displayed integral in u=x+y;
the factor u and the denominator exponent4 are correct.

I independently derived all four facet contributions. The coordinate
facets contribute2t times the f-integral. The inner diagonal contributes
h(2t-h)f(h). In the old perspective the outer support ratio changes the
argument to f(1), giving r(r-2t)f(1). The actual tilted H2 cut on its
captured coordinate facet begins at r-2+4t; its captured outer diagonal
has coordinate length2t. These give the printed L2 expression. The
one-input field doubles the middle support, changes the scalar density
to g(u), and leaves those SAME geometric cap crossings, giving precisely
the displayed DO and Oj formulas.

The exact antiderivatives I and J have the stated product denominators;
there is no missing scalar c or c/2. Every evaluated density remains
on the inverse-square branch, above the fixed tangent cutoff. The
algebraic normalization is the admissible quadratic root, with the
other root excluded by positivity at the inner facet.

The positive lower bound for EVERY smaller-input fixed-row surplus
and the unchanged middle-plane cover imply actual global descent using
the strict endpoint isolation gaps. The larger-input negative test is
not mistaken for a proof of global ascent. The old path's mixed row
signs are also correctly distinguished from its positive weighted
response. Neither source drops cap tilts, supporting statuses, or
the original total mass in its comparison.

## Homothetic contact facet

Under the stated common simple normal fan, small facet-number changes
preserve the fan. Minkowski averaging then moves only the selected
source facet, at the averaged support speed. Both endpoints and source
are genuine nested polytopes with exact midpoint compatibility.

The common positive homothetic facet parametrization maps normalized
area uniformly. The chosen speeds make the two endpoint area costs
equal. Affineness of the ambient cap margin at an actual midpoint,
also after the inward displacements whose speeds average correctly,
gives the same pointwise implication for ALL cap bits. It includes a
facet coincidence through the inward status rather than its incorrect
closed face trace. Integrating yields exactly1+rho units of source
trace at1+2rho units of source cost, with0<rho<=1, hence the stated
local2/3 factor. Normal-dependent rho changes both global weights;
the source properly forbids multiplying that local ratio by an
unmodified ordinary Gamma theorem without a further argument.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
